reason: Driven and measured, and every load-bearing number in the finding reproduces. Deleting all seven moments on owner-flight at 1440x960 leaves .b-measure at height:1514px with zero .b-item children, .b-plan.scrollTop parked at 937 (967 at 1280x900), and a query for every leaf node with text intersecting the pane's box returns an EMPTY ARRAY: the 'days away' head sits at top:-686 and 'Today, 16 July' at top:-655, both above the pane's edge, and 'Behind you, 3 moments' is below its bottom. The right half of the owner's desk is one 620px hairline over black. This is not scroll-offset luck - deleting farthest-first leaves scrollTop at 181 and the pane is still visibly empty, because 1514px of measure now stands on nothing. At 390 and 768 the pane does not scroll, so the head and origin survive, but the measure still reserves 1198px/1514px of bare rule between 'Today, 16 July' and 'Behind you' - the same defect, differently shaped. Nothing anywhere in the region says it is empty: grep of b.css finds :empty rules for .b-behindDate, .b-editHost and .b-undo, and none for .b-measure. Not restated by the gates: interaction-check.mjs deletes exactly one moment (lines 555-561, 888-917) and never reaches zero; no assertion in 605 covers an empty plan. Not already handled: 'Add a moment' does sit in the persistent bar and does take focus after the last delete, and the undo bar reads 'Wedding day was removed.' with Undo - that is a way BACK, and a global control, but the lessons library's rule is that every other empty region says something true about what belongs there, and this region says nothing while showing nothing. Not a constraint breach: the fix is a sentence, a height and a scroll offset - no colour, no weight, no architecture. Not a duplicate of the owner-empty copy: the new-project screen is a standalone .b-empty composition with no measure, no rail and no 'Behind you' in it, and its sentence ('Nothing sits between today and the day yet') is about a day just set; an emptied plan already has its count, its day and three past moments on screen, so it needs a different sentence in a different region. Shared vocabulary there is consistency, not repetition. One correction to the finding's own evidence, which sharpens rather than kills it - see sharpenedFix.
sharpenedFix: Take all four parts, with the rail part re-argued and the geometry part widened. (1) The rail sentence: the finding's example is the one benign case. Deleting nearest-first freezes .b-gapNote at 'Nothing is planned until 3 October.', and 3 October IS the day, stated three lines above as 'Saturday 3 October 2026 / Wedding day' - so that sentence reads TRUE. The mechanism is still broken, and deleting farthest-first proves it: the note freezes at 'Nothing is planned until 1 August.', a date that now holds nothing, because place() only writes the note under `if (note && items.length)`. Fix the guard, not the wording of one instance: when items.length === 0, write 'Nothing is planned yet.' Argue it on the reverse-order case, which is a plain falsehood, not on the 3 October case, which is not. (2) Size the measure to its content at zero, and do it at EVERY width, not only where the pane scrolls - the 1198px bare rule at 390 is the same defect and is the width a founder will demo. In place(), when items.length === 0, skip the horizonDays * px + ROW floor. (3) Reset .b-plan.scrollTop to 0 in the same frame, but only where paneOf(root) returns a scroller, and only on the transition to zero - not on every repaint, or it will fight holdingPlace() and the undo path, which currently re-lands its restored row correctly (measured: after Undo from empty, the row returns at top:767, inside the pane). (4) Render one line under the 'days away' head at zero, worded for this route, e.g. 'Nothing is on the plan. Anything you add appears here, measured from the day.' One sentence, once - the head plus the origin plus this line is already three pieces of text in a small region, so do not add a second call to action; the 'Add a moment' control in the bar is four hundred pixels away and already has focus.
